task: Open https://example.com and report the page heading shown at the top of the page.
description: The known-good Phase 8 task: one static page, one heading on it.

task: Open https://example.com and report what this domain says it is intended to be used for.
description: A second fact on the same stable page, so a pass is not the same observation twice.

task: Open https://docs.python.org/3/library/index.html and report the name of the documentation section you are reading.
description: A documentation page fact that does not change with releases.

task: Open https://www.gnu.org/licenses/licenses.en.html and report the full name of the license abbreviated as the GNU GPL.
description: A long-standing legal page whose core wording is stable.

task: Find the GitHub repository of the browser-use project and report the primary programming language it is written in.
description: A project page task. It asks for a language, not a count, so the gold does not rot.

task: Open https://example.com, follow the single link near the bottom of the page, and report the domain name of the page it leads to.
description: Needs at least two page views, so evidence from more than one capture has to be used.

task: Open https://example.com, report the page heading, and say which organisation manages this domain.
description: The checker only requires the heading, which the page states. The manager is never named on the page, so any answer about it is a claim the evidence layer has to judge on its own.
